title: Kestrel Advantage Balloon Rate Sheet by Credit Tier
content:
This rate sheet sets, for each tier of the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, the credit score band that places an applicant in the tier, the contract APR for each term band, and the range of terms and amounts financed the tier may book.

## Score bands, terms and amounts

The credit score is the FICO Auto Score 8 on the 250 to 900 scale. A tier admits scores from its lowest score through its highest score, both included. Terms are stated in months and amounts financed in USD.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowest credit score admitted | 580 | 620 | 650 | 680 | 710 | 740 |
| Highest credit score admitted | 619 | 649 | 679 | 709 | 739 | 900 |
| Shortest term (months) | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Longest term (months) | 48 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |
| Smallest amount financed (USD) | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 | 10000.00 |
| Largest amount financed (USD) | 40000.00 | 50000.00 | 62000.00 | 75000.00 | 90000.00 | 110000.00 |

## Contract APR by term band

The contract APR is stated in percent to two decimals for each band of term months. Where a band reads "not offered", the tier cannot book a contract whose term falls in that band.

| | Tier 5 | Tier 4 | Tier 3 | Tier 2 | Tier 1 | Tier 1+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Term 24 to 36 months | 12.99% | 10.74% | 8.99% | 7.24% | 6.24% | 5.49% |
| Term 37 to 48 months | 13.49% | 11.24% | 9.24% | 7.49% | 6.49% | 5.74% |
| Term 49 to 60 months | not offered | 11.74% | 9.74% | 7.99% | 6.99% | 6.24% |

## Reading the sheet

- **Band edges.** Each band includes both of its end points: a 36-month term reads from the 24 to 36 band and a 37-month term from the 37 to 48 band.
- **Tier 5 and long terms.** Kestrel Advantage Balloon Tier 5 shows "not offered" for the 49 to 60 band, and its longest term is 48 months.
- **Score edges.** A score equal to a tier's lowest or highest admitted score falls inside that tier; for example, a score of 650 sits in Tier 3 and a score of 649 in Tier 4.

*Hypothetical illustration (inputs chosen for this note only):* an applicant scored 700 asking for a 42-month term falls in Tier 2 and reads the 37 to 48 band, 7.49%.
